name: FourieRF
aliases: FourieRF: Few-Shot NeRFs via Progressive Fourier Frequency Control
definition: A few-shot NeRF estimation method that parameterizes grid-based NeRF features using a Fourier Transform prior to control frequency bands, avoiding high-frequency artifacts and overfitting in sparse data scenarios.
summary: FourieRF is a few-shot NeRF method that prevents overfitting by progressively increasing learnable Fourier frequencies in grid-based features.
